name: Grégoire Lefèbvre Investigations: The Vow of Hate
aliases: Les enquêtes de Grégoire Lefèbvre : Le Serment de Haine

locations.note: In July 1799 gendarmerie captain Grégoire Lefèbvre, new to the department of the Ourthe, investigates the murder of Nicolas Richelle, the village's despised constitutional priest, found tortured in his ransacked presbytery.
